properties.name: profileProps
properties.description: Profile menu properties containing user information

properties.name: menuOne
properties.description: Configuration for the first menu including title and items

properties.name: menuTwo
properties.description: Configuration for the second menu including title and items

properties.name: mainMenu
properties.description: Configuration for the default main menu section. When omitted, all built-in items render in the default order. When provided, boolean flags control each built-in item and `items` appends custom entries.

properties.name: showSignOut
properties.description: Controls visibility of the Sign Out menu item in the footer. Defaults to true when omitted.

events.name: signOutClick
events.description: Emitted when the Sign Out menu item is clicked

events.name: menuItemClick
events.description: Emitted when any menu item is clicked, passing back the item value or label
